title: MeetsMore (Mitsumoa) says member data leaked through contractor PLAID's KARTE breach
what_changed: The company's name was misspelled as Mitsumo; its own notice names it 株式会社ミツモア (MeetsMore Inc.). That notice of 18 November was read and added as the primary source; the date_note now gives its stated PLAID notification dates (13 and 17 November). Figures unchanged. Validation changed from single_source to corroborated (primary source).
